tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Primary. Cover, section dividers, agenda, closing slide, dark content slides, titles on light slides. Text on it: white or cyan only.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Primary accent. Chevron blades, column labels, eyebrows and numbers on navy, timeline highlights. Text on it: navy only.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Secondary. Agenda disc, timeline bars, icon rings, headings inside content, links. Text on it: white.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Accent, about 10% of a deck. Title underline rule, milestone diamonds, go-live, the one thing that needs attention. Never a dominant field. Text on it: white.

tokens.name: smoke
tokens.usage: Secondary neutral. Table header rows, card fills, timeline grid lines on light slides. Text on it: navy, blue, charcoal or orange.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Body text on light slides. Also a dark field in rare cases; text on it white or cyan.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Light slide background, text on navy, blue and orange.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The slide background: white on a light slide, navy on a dark one. Every section sets it explicitly.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles: navy on light, white on navy.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Body text: charcoal on light, white on navy.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, footers, secondary labels. 4.5:1 on its surface.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, column labels, numbers: blue on light, cyan on navy.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and table-header fill. One step off the surface, no shadow.

tokens.name: card-line
tokens.usage: Card and table rules, 1px.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The 6px-tall, 72px-wide orange rule under a slide title.

tokens.name: cyan-100
tokens.usage: Lightest cyan tint (Brand Playbook tint 5). Chevron blade highlights.

tokens.name: cyan-200
tokens.usage: Cyan tint 4. Top chevron blade on covers.

tokens.name: cyan-400
tokens.usage: Cyan tint 2.

tokens.name: cyan-500
tokens.usage: Cyan tint 1 (darkest cyan). Chart series when cyan is too light.

tokens.name: blue-100
tokens.usage: Blue tint 5. Second timeline bar tone.

tokens.name: blue-200
tokens.usage: Blue tint 4. Middle chevron blade on covers.

tokens.name: blue-400
tokens.usage: Blue tint 2.

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: Blue tint 1. Bottom chevron blade on covers.

tokens.name: navy-100
tokens.usage: Navy tint 5. Lightest navy; card fills on navy slides.

tokens.name: navy-200
tokens.usage: Navy tint 4. Rules on navy slides.

tokens.name: navy-400
tokens.usage: Navy tint 2.

tokens.name: navy-500
tokens.usage: Navy tint 1. Deepest navy; the lower blade on a navy cover.

tokens.name: orange-100
tokens.usage: Orange tint 5.

tokens.name: orange-200
tokens.usage: Orange tint 4. Start of the approved orange gradient.

tokens.name: orange-300
tokens.usage: Orange tint 3.

tokens.name: orange-500
tokens.usage: Orange tint 1. Orange text on smoke when 4.5:1 is needed.

tokens.name: smoke-100
tokens.usage: Smoke tint 5. Card fill on white.

tokens.name: smoke-300
tokens.usage: Smoke tint 3. Table rules, grid lines.

tokens.name: smoke-400
tokens.usage: Smoke tint 2. Disabled or future-phase bars.

tokens.name: smoke-500
tokens.usage: Smoke tint 1. Break-week dashed bar.

tokens.name: charcoal-100
tokens.usage: Charcoal tint 5.

tokens.name: charcoal-200
tokens.usage: Charcoal tint 4. Muted text on white.

tokens.name: charcoal-400
tokens.usage: Charcoal tint 2.

tokens.name: charcoal-500
tokens.usage: Charcoal tint 1.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Closed, done, confirmed. Only as a small dot, check or tint; never a field. Pairs with open-amber by lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Panel fill behind closed or confirmed items.

tokens.name: open-tint
tokens.usage: Panel fill behind open items and risks; the text on it is orange-500 or white.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Closing slide and single-statement slides. Navy or white.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: Cover title, white on navy, two lines at most, 1100px wide.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section divider title, centered, white on navy.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: Every content slide title, one line, at the top margin. Navy on light, white on navy. The orange rule sits 20px under it.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Card titles, step titles, big-number labels. Inter SemiBold.

styles.name: big-number
styles.usage: Step numbers and statistics. Blue on light, cyan on navy.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Phase 1 makes Salesforce the system of record for matters, clients and payers.
styles.usage: The one-sentence intro under a title. Charcoal on light, white on navy. 1400px wide at most.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Discovery sessions run Tuesdays and Thursdays.
styles.usage: Bullets, card text, table cells. Never smaller than 28px in a table.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Key terms inline, names, table first column.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Dense tables, titles under names, bar labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: All caps label above a heading or a card. Blue on light, cyan on navy. Source Sans Bold.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Notes under timelines and tables, the footer row. Muted.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Slide padding on all sides (1664 by 824 inside). Footer slides: 160px bottom.

tokens.name: gap-xl
tokens.usage: Between the title block and the body.

tokens.name: gap-lg
tokens.usage: Between columns and card rows.

tokens.name: gap-md
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid, between a heading and its text, table cell padding.

tokens.name: gap-sm
tokens.usage: Inside a card between title and text; between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: gap-xs
tokens.usage: Between the title and the orange rule's box; hairline offsets.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: headshot
tokens.usage: Circular headshot diameter on team slides (96px in a five-row table).

tokens.name: icon-ring
tokens.usage: Icon ring diameter on the Why-we-are-here row.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Timeline bars, table header corners, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, client-logo card on the cover, screenshot frames.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Headshots, icon rings, dots.

tokens.name: title-rule
tokens.usage: Height of the orange rule under a slide title (72px wide).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Icon ring stroke on the Why-we-are-here row.

tokens.name: headshot-ring
tokens.usage: White ring around a headshot on navy.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Table and card rules in card-line.
